text: Applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens with valid passports, be in good health with good conduct, and abide by laws and regulations of the Chinese government as well as rules and regulations of the school.Applicants who apply for a bachelor's degree shall have a high school education or above, and generally no more than 35 years old.Applicants' academic achievement and language ability shall satisfy the entrance requirements of the applied majors, a 4-point IELTS score (or equivalent level) in English Lectures.
